objective: actual PAPER fills and positive fill-conditioned audited post-cost PnL

finding.pre_fix_behavior: orders, positions and markout_watch were pooled into one continuity gate; a missing measurement-only markout market/book could return FAIL_CLOSED_NO_REPLAY_NO_CANCEL and therefore stall unrelated tape replay and cancel finalization
finding.economic_risk: measurement-only 45/60/300s watches can persist after a position closes; tying them to execution continuity can inflate zero-fill/dead-queue capital time without improving safety

fix.execution_continuity: orders and open positions remain fail-closed before tape replay
fix.markout_continuity: markout_watch gaps are audited separately and never block unrelated execution; strict bounded-delay markout filtering remains authoritative
fix.cancel_contract: OPEN -> CANCEL_PENDING -> CANCELLED latency and delayed pre-cancel replay remain unchanged

deterministic_regressions: missing order/position market or token book still blocks replay and cancel finalization
missing markout-only market or token book does not block replay
delayed pre-cancel fills and explicit cancel latency remain unchanged
